artifact: WETA Bay shuttle candidates and waypoint gate
finding: The existing pta_hand_waypoints_sf_bay_ferry.json contains 17 route keys but every waypoint array is empty. Existing route metadata reports zero interior land distance, but that is not sufficient evidence for bridge-span, shoal, marsh, estuary, or terminal-basin safety.
rules: Existing WETA service, WETA-published expansion, Golden Gate Ferry context, and Navier candidate screens must remain separate.
Corridors are global canonical geography; accepted routes are minted once under san-francisco-bay-usa and inherited, never authored as WETA-only routes.
A canonical POI ID proves a mapped facility, not passenger-vessel, commercial-use, ADA, charging, berth, environmental, or operator approval.
All candidate route IDs remain null until selected, hand-waypointed, and accepted with interior_land_km == 0 plus visual bridge/channel QA.
